answer: Each identity must bind one accredited university degree, verified against the education registry: certificate hash, graduation year and holder name must match, one degree per identity. Earning one takes four years and 8,000 units of tuition plus a 300-unit fee, so each fake costs 8,300 units and four years; 100 fakes cost 830,000 units and 400 student-years, a dune no script can flatten. A forged diploma fails the registry check, and a bought degree dies when the accreditor revokes it. The ledge is the registry: no entry, no standing. Like an opal, a degree's worth is its verifiable history.
